name: Emergency Braking Distance
description: Emergency braking distance from line speed on wet rails. Checks whether train stops before an obstacle.

elements.name: Emergency Braking Distance
elements.description: Distance from emergency brake application to standstill at 160 km/h. Uncertain due to adhesion and wheel condition.

uncertainty.source: Braking model with EN 14531 adhesion coefficient range

elements.name: Available Braking Distance
elements.description: Overlap distance between danger point and signal on this route

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(d_brake) = d_brake if d_brake <= d_avail, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The available overlap distance guards the braking distance uncertainty set; stopping distances above 1000 m lead to danger point overrun.
